deliverable_2_bootstrap_diagnosis.diagnosis_class: Low unconditional survival may reflect path fragility; year-bias not dominant by coarse flags.
deliverable_2_bootstrap_diagnosis.proposed_bootstrap_revision: Stratified resampling: partition trade indices by calendar year of exit_ny; resample blocks within each stratum so bootstrap paths match source year fractions; or circular block bootstrap without replacement across years. **Not implemented in Wave 0e — operator approval required.**
deliverable_2_bootstrap_diagnosis.stop_recommendation_strict_reading: If diagnosis_class implies resampling artifact, pause before trusting unconditional block-20 survival; conditional rates and block-1 baseline are diagnostic only.
